note: The head-side pairs a FROZEN-encoder proxy can re-run, with what they scored FINE-TUNED. `python -m kneemri.training.head_trial --correlate` reruns each pair on cached features and reports whether the ordering survives. A pair is only scored if the fine-tuned reading RESOLVES it (|delta| >= floor 0.0062, the three-seed spread on that ruler) — the same discipline board_transfer applies to leaderboard pairs, and for the same reason: a proxy that 'agrees' with a pair the ruler could not read has agreed with noise.

Only three head-side pairs exist in the record at all. One (channel-stacked groups vs per-slice max, +0.0018) is NOT listed: `channels` stacks slices before the encoder, so cached features cannot express its control, and a pair whose two sides collapse to the same trial would report a structural zero that reads like a measurement. The two that remain are one resolved pair and one inside the floor. That is the finding this file makes visible: the harness cannot yet be trusted to rank head variants, because there is almost nothing measured to rank it against. Adding a pair here means running the pixel arm, not editing this line.
